messages:
Ashley: Heads-up: PR #412 stuck in GH Actions. Eval job queued for >30m then timed out. Seen on two PRs this morning. cc @Vinh @Matt

Ashley: Logs show queued reason "no-self-hosted-runner-available" and queued_for ~1800s:

```
Run eval-runner
Status: queued
queued_for: 1800s
reason: no-self-hosted-runner-available
jobs: eval-suite
```

Vinh: Are those self-hosted runners only? Can you paste the workflow snippet and the runs-on labels?

Ashley: Self-hosted with tag `eval`. Workflow snippet:

```yaml
jobs:
  eval-suite:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, eval]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: make run-evals
```

Sara: We hit the same behavior during the nightly replay window — autoscaler saturation. Buildkite connector may be launching a burst and stealing capacity. Suggest: add small PR smoke on GH-hosted, and move full evals to nightly or dedicated Buildkite builders.

Matt: Autoscaler logs show quota_exceeded and many in-flight launches failing:

```
ERROR autoscaler: launch request failed: quota_exceeded
WARN autoscaler: too many in-flight instance launches
```

deploy-bot: Workflow run 123456789 for branch `feat/quantize-123` failed: eval-suite queued > 3600s — https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/123456789

Ashley: Temporary mitigation: quick push to retrigger or tag PR `skip-gha-eval` to route heavy runs to Buildkite. Not sustainable.

Vinh: Quick plan: add `pr/eval-smoke` job that runs a tiny subset on `ubuntu-latest` (GH-hosted) as a fast sanity gate. Full evals only run nightly or on Buildkite. I'll open a PR to add smoke job and a `runs-on` fallback.

Sara: Also: alert if queued_time > 300s for eval jobs -> page `oncall-sre` + mute escalation to SRE if transient. And add exponential backoff to eval-runner submit logic to avoid thundering herd.

Matt: I'll investigate autoscaler quotas and bump desired capacity for `eval` tag pools, and check for spot churn. Will post a short runbook with actions.

Ashley: Action items:
- Vinh: open PR for GH Actions smoke + ubuntu-hosted fallback (ETA: today)
- Matt: triage autoscaler + increase capacity for eval-tag (ETA: tomorrow)
- Sara: add metric & alert for queued_time and update CI gating doc (ETA: EOD)

Vinh: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/pull/789 — adds `pr/eval-smoke` with fallback and a lightweight matrix. Assigning Ashley for review.

Ashley: Reviewing now. If smoke passes we can unstick PR queue and monitor queued_time.

Matt: Will post autoscaler logs and a short runbook once triage done.

Sara: Drafting the alert rule and will add note in the eval CI runbook about preferring Buildkite for heavy runs.

Ashley: Thanks — keep updates here. Tag @oncall-sre if queued events repeat. :thumbsup:
